append.detail: CLOSED 2026-10-05: saveFunnelOverride and deleteFunnelVersion in lib/funnels/overrides.ts read { error } and throw on it (setFunnelPublishStatus and duplicateFunnel inherit the check). renameFunnelSlug wraps the save in try/catch, reads the new row back with getFunnelOverride(next) and only then deletes the old slug, returning { ok: false, error } at each failed step. saveFunnelVersion, saveDefaultFunnelCopy and resetDefaultFunnelCopy return { ok: false } on a caught failure so the editor's existing Could not save branch runs.
